sentences.text: Harry Edward Styles -LRB- born 1 February 1994 -RRB- is an English singer and songwriter .
He is known as a member of the pop boy band One Direction .	pop	Pop music	One Direction	One Direction	boy band	boy band
He made his debut as a singer with his band White Eskimo , who performed locally in Holmes Chapel , Cheshire .	Holmes Chapel	Holmes Chapel	Cheshire	Cheshire
In 2010 , Styles auditioned as a solo artist for the British television series The X Factor .	British television series	Television in the United Kingdom	The X Factor	The X Factor (UK TV series)

After being eliminated as a solo performer , Styles was brought back into the competition , along with four other contestants , Niall Horan , Zayn Malik , Liam Payne and Louis Tomlinson , to form One Direction .	One Direction	One Direction	Niall Horan	Niall Horan	Zayn Malik	Zayn Malik	Liam Payne	Liam Payne	Louis Tomlinson	Louis Tomlinson

Styles and his bandmates have released the albums Up All Night -LRB- 2011 -RRB- , Take Me Home -LRB- 2012 -RRB- , Midnight Memories -LRB- 2013 -RRB- , Four -LRB- 2014 -RRB- , and Made in the A.M. -LRB- 2015 -RRB- .	Up All Night	Up All Night (One Direction album)	Take Me Home	Take Me Home (One Direction album)	Midnight Memories	Midnight Memories	Four	Four (One Direction album)

They have also performed on two worldwide tours , one featured on concert film One Direction : This Is Us , and won several awards , including five Brit Awards and four MTV Video Music Awards .	One Direction	One Direction	MTV Video Music Awards	MTV Video Music Awards
